text: ともだちと　むし　ポケモン　とりに　きてるんだ！

structure.jp: むし　ポケモン　とりに

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb with its ます cut off plus に before a verb of coming or going says what you come to do. とりに　きてる = 'have come to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: て plus いる after a verb says a state is going on now; てる is the short spoken form. きてる = 'have come and am here'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end, the spoken form of のだ, gives the feeling of explaining your situation. きてるんだ = 'you see, I'm here'.
